column1: GERMAN 3341F - LIT & CULTURE OF MIDDLE AGES
column2: Course Description: Study the 12th century revitalized intellectual life in Europe, and the great medieval works of chivalry and romantic love in their cultural context. Gain indepth knowledge of castle and cathedral architecture, fashion, food, travel, sexuality, courtly love, and the hunt in text and image.
